name: Cold brew, demo org
product: Slow-steeped cold brew coffee in a slim can (18-hour steep, small batches, no added sugar)
voiceoverNote: This ad has no voiceover. Scene clips carry only ambient sound. On-screen captions carry the script, so the viewer reads it.

scenes.copy: Okay, confession: you think black coffee tastes like burnt toast. Fair. Most of it kinda does.
scenes.visual: A busy city sidewalk outside a small corner cafe with a fogged front window and a morning queue spilling out the door.

scenes.copy: Here's the thing, bitterness usually comes from rushing it. We don't rush.
scenes.visual: A busy city sidewalk outside a small corner cafe with a fogged front window and a morning queue spilling out the door.

scenes.copy: Our cold brew steeps slow for eighteen whole hours, in small batches, until it's deep, mellow, and genuinely smooth. Never bitter.
scenes.visual: A small city apartment kitchen with a white laminate counter, a stainless-steel fridge, a round wall clock, and a single dim overhead light.

scenes.copy: No added sugar, and honestly? You won't miss it.
scenes.visual: An open-plan office desk by a large window, with a laptop, scattered papers, a mug of pens, and flat fluorescent light mixed with grey daylight.

scenes.copy: It's just good coffee, the way it should've tasted all along, in a slim can you can take anywhere.

scenes.copy: Grab a can, take one sip straight from the fridge, and taste the difference. Find it at your store today.
